transcriber_notes: niViz chart (low-resolution JPEG, 1.94 px/cm). Hand hardness index [N] axis 0-1000 with F/4F/1F/P/K labels, bars grow leftward and are coloured by grain type (green DF, light blue FC/FCxr, red MFcr). Columns θ, F, E, R, a threshold-sum marker column (E R F ΔE ΔR Depth triangles, not transcribed) and CT. Boundaries from bar edges and slanted leader lines, +-0.7 cm: 77 (bar top), 66, 58, 47, 37, 13; the first table row (DF, R 1) has its leader line starting at the bar top, so it is a surface layer below chart resolution (bottom null). Hardness from the numeric R column (1, 1, 1.33, 5, 3, 2, 3), consistent with bar ends. θ (moisture) column blank throughout. Temperature is a red line without point markers: break points 67, 60, 51 (drawn over the red crust bar, read from the darker line pixels), 20.5 cm plus ends 77 and 0 cm, read on the bottom axis (-20..0 C, 15 px/C, +-0.2 C). HS not printed, hs_cm left null.
